verdict: Google Business Profile activity is falling sharply; paid channels remain paused.
narrative: Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel this period, with no paid advertising running across all 28 days. Profile actions totaled 51 for the period, but that number is declining fast — the most recent 3 days (Oct 3–5) produced just 2 actions compared to 9 in the 3 days prior, confirming the drop is accelerating. Reduced local search visibility is driving this, with search clicks also falling to zero in the same window. Website sessions have held relatively steady thanks to direct and referral traffic, which is a partial buffer, but it does not offset the erosion in organic local reach. We are reviewing the profile's search visibility now to identify what's pulling impressions down and will have a clearer picture next week.
